summary: Dual wavelength transmission and AC/DC principle only; numeric coefficients below are project-authored.

input: AcqPleth125@1 acquired relative peripheral pulse, including existing perfusion and missing ejection effects
measurement: 500 paired samples; independent window means and AC RMS ratio; no target passed to calculator
engineering_acceptance: Acquired reference and 2:1 examples at75/90/98/99 percent recover within0.5 percentage point; not a clinical accuracy statement
limitations: Affine small-modulation illustration; window mean and quantization cause target/measurement differences
No oxygen transport, tissue model, hardware calibration, motion rejection or extended saturation range
Quality flags are retained; clipped input becomes invalid optical input; constant light does not yield saturation
A new sensor instance is mandatory when target/model changes; does not define new frozen acquisition profiles
Preview UI, common live owner and sound/alarm integration remain separate
perfusion_index: IR peak-to-peak / IR window mean * 100 percent, 500 samples; teaching estimate, not vendor algorithm
